The '''Master in White''' was the name taken by the leader of the [[Wookiee Liberation Front]]. Leader of the [[Five Masters]], and maintained the White Gallery at the [[Five Masters Academy|Training Hall]] outside [[Gadrin]]. At the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Master in White and his students were all killed in the White Gallery, defending the academy from the mysterious force that destroyed the Academy.
